quests.conceptTitle: Preposition Radar: Contrast: results in vs results from
quests.spatialHierarchy: Enclosed Space / Volume (e.g. in the room)
quests.question: Poor communication often results ___ costly misunderstandings at work.

quests.grammarRule: Contrast: results in vs results from
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Results in' shows a cause leading to an effect, in that order; 'results from' would need the order reversed, naming the effect first.
quests.nativeTip: The cause comes first here, followed by its effect.
quests.visualAnchor: 🧭 Preposition 'in' (Enclosed Space / Volume (e.g. in the room)) ➔ 'Poor communication often results in costly misunderstandings at work.'
